subject: PR-865 other four reds: 3 are the same secret; Test is 9 pre-existing + 1 ledger
body:
OBSERVATION. Five checks red at b71d9c04. I read the job logs and GitHub annotations. I did not assume they were the same bug.

1. GitGuardian Security Checks: FAIL. Incident 37443000, PostgreSQL Credentials in psql-readonly.test.ts. SYNTHETIC (see prior finding). Do not rotate.
2. Secret scan (full tree): FAIL. scripts/guardrails/secret-scan.mjs --all, rule db.url.with-password, same file line 9.
3. All guardrails: FAIL. 25/26. The one failure is secret-scan. Same finding.
4. No-cost FABLE evidence checks: FAIL. fable:evidence OK. vitest 3 files, 10 passed. Then npm run guard:secrets failed on the same line 9. Same finding.
5. Test, type-check, lint, Prisma: FAIL. 10 vitest failures, no typecheck/lint annotation. Names:
   - agent-ledger.test.ts:57 F-GROK-PUSH DONE with no SHA or #PR. THIS PR (144d0f2). I will cite #865.
   - board-pass-reason-honesty.test.ts:122,131
   - board-gate-page.test.tsx:79
   - board-gate-consumer.test.ts:266 (test asks for British 'judgement'; copy says American 'judgment')
   - board-class-banner-honesty.test.ts:15,24
   - analytics-instrumentation.test.tsx:68,92,114 (checkout CTA no longer has date-of-birth)
   Those 9 are on main at 47be639 (job 105703070978) and on this PR at 7a5bd38 before the CWE-214 commit. This PR did not introduce them. Domain 3 / apps/web. I will not steal that lane to make this PR's Test job look greener than main.

Codacy: 1 critical security, 1 medium compatibility. App is login-walled from here. INFERENCE: critical is the same DSN. Medium unread; will not guess a file.

HISTORY. Fixture is synthetic. I will not rewrite b71d9c0. Founder call if he wants history gone anyway.

Fixing the fixture (assemble sentinel at runtime, no credential shape in the file) and F-GROK-PUSH evidence. GEM-2 still paused. SCORE-VETO is grok's (saved locally at grok/2026-09-18-score-veto, not in this commit).
